breakdown.description: The prescribed global horizontal point load is projected onto the local normal direction of the skew boundary
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still instructs to resolve the global horizontal load into the local normal direction of the skew boundary and apply only that normal component, which is exactly the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires applying the full horizontal point load directly at (1.1, 0.15) without any projection onto the boundary normal. The agent repeated the incorrect instruction rather than fixing it.
